",
      hint:"Taquilla abierta · dos soportes.",
      filename:"Pavon_taquilla_abierta.png"
    }
  };

  let activePage = "taquilla";
  let selected = null;
  const allSlots = [...document.querySelectorAll(".slot")];
  const state = {};

  allSlots.forEach(slot => {
    state[slot.dataset.page + ":" + slot.dataset.id] = {dataUrl:null,mode:"contain"};
  });

  const fileInput = document.getElementById("fileInput");
  const selectedTitle = document.getElementById("selectedTitle");
  const selectedMeta = document.getElementById("selectedMeta");
  const loadBtn = document.getElementById("loadBtn");
  const fitBtn = document.getElementById("fitBtn");
  const removeBtn = document.getElementById("removeBtn");
  const clearBtn = document.getElementById("clearBtn");
  const exportBtn = document.getElementById("exportBtn");
  const slotList = document.getElementById("slotList");
  const pageHint = document.getElementById("pageHint");
  const zoomRange = document.getElementById("zoomRange");
  const zoomValue = document.getElementById("zoomValue");
  const calendarGrid = document.getElementById("calendarGrid");
  const lightbox = document.getElementById("lightbox");
  const lightboxImage = document.getElementById("lightboxImage");
  const lightboxClose = document.getElementById("lightboxClose");
  const canvasShells = [...document.querySelectorAll(".canvas-shell")];

  function scheduleKey(slot, field) {
    return "pavon_schedule_" + slot.dataset.page + "_" + slot.dataset.id + "_" + field;
  }

  function applyZoom(value) {
    canvasShells.forEach(shell => shell.style.width = value + "%");
    zoomValue.textContent = value + "%";
    try { localStorage.setItem("pavon_stage_zoom", value); } catch(e) {}
  }

  function renderCalendar() {
    calendarGrid.innerHTML = "";
    activeSlots().forEach(slot => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "calendar-row";

      const title = document.createElement("div");
      title.className = "calendar-space";
      title.textContent = slot.dataset.name;

      const fields = document.createElement("div");
      fields.className = "calendar-fields";

      const dateInput = document.createElement("input");
      dateInput.type = "text";
      dateInput.placeholder = "Fecha";
      dateInput.value = (() => {
        try { return localStorage.getItem(scheduleKey(slot, "date")) || ""; } catch(e) { return ""; }
      })();
      dateInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
        try { localStorage.setItem(scheduleKey(slot, "date"), dateInput.value); } catch(e) {}
      });

      const nextInput = document.createElement("input");
      nextInput.type = "text";
      nextInput.placeholder = "Próximo";
      nextInput.value = (() => {
        try { return localStorage.getItem(scheduleKey(slot, "next")) || ""; } catch(e) { return ""; }
      })();
      nextInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
        try { localStorage.setItem(scheduleKey(slot, "next"), nextInput.value); } catch(e) {}
      });

      fields.append(dateInput, nextInput);
      row.append(title, fields);
      calendarGrid.appendChild(row);
    });
  }


  function key(slot) {
    return slot.dataset.page + ":" + slot.dataset.id;
  }

  function activeSlots() {
    return allSlots.filter(s => s.dataset.page === activePage);
  }

  function selectSlot(slot) {
    allSlots.forEach(s => s.classList.remove("selected"));
    selected = slot && slot.dataset.page === activePage ? slot : null;

    if (selected) {
      selected.classList.add("selected");
      const s = state[key(selected)];
      selectedTitle.textContent = selected.dataset.name;
      selectedMeta.textContent = s.dataUrl
        ? `Cartel cargado · modo ${s.mode === "contain" ? "encajar" : "llenar"}`
        : "Vacío · listo para cargar imagen";
      loadBtn.disabled = false;
      fitBtn.disabled = !s.dataUrl;
      removeBtn.disabled = !s.dataUrl;
      fitBtn.textContent = `Modo: ${s.mode === "contain" ? "encajar" : "llenar"}`;
    } else {
      selectedTitle.textContent = "Ningún soporte seleccionado";
      selectedMeta.textContent = "Selecciona un hueco negro.";
      loadBtn.disabled = true;
      fitBtn.disabled = true;
      removeBtn.disabled = true;
      fitBtn.textContent = "Modo: encajar";
    }
    renderList();
    renderCalendar();
  }

  function renderList() {
    slotList.innerHTML = "";
    activeSlots().forEach(slot => {
      const s = state[key(slot)];
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "slot-row";

      const info = document.createElement("div");
      info.innerHTML = `<div class="slot-name">${slot.dataset.name}</div>
                        <div class="status ${s.dataUrl ? "loaded" : ""}">${s.dataUrl ? "cargado" : "vacío"}</div>`;

      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.textContent = s.dataUrl ? "Cambiar" : "Cargar";
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        selectSlot(slot);
        fileInput.click();
      });

      row.append(info, btn);
      slotList.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function switchPage(page) {
    activePage = page;
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(t => t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.view === page));
    document.querySelectorAll(".view").forEach(v => v.classList.toggle("active", v.dataset.view === page));
    pageHint.textContent = configs[page].hint;
    selectSlot(null);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener("click", () => switchPage(tab.dataset.view));
  });

  function setImage(slot, dataUrl) {
    const media = slot.querySelector(".media");
    let img = media.querySelector("img");
    if (!img) {
      img = document.createElement("img");
      media.appendChild(img);
    }
    img.src = dataUrl;
    img.style.objectFit = state[key(slot)].mode;
    state[key(slot)].dataUrl = dataUrl;
    selectSlot(slot);
  }

  function loadFile(file, slot) {
    if (!file || !file.type.startsWith("image/")) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = e => setImage(slot, e.target.result);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  allSlots.forEach(slot => {
    slot.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (slot.dataset.page !== activePage) return;
      selectSlot(slot);
      if (!state[key(slot)].dataUrl) fileInput.click();
    });

    slot.addEventListener("dragover", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      slot.classList.add("drag");
    });

    slot.addEventListener("dragleave", () => slot.classList.remove("drag"));

    slot.addEventListener("drop", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      slot.classList.remove("drag");
      if (slot.dataset.page !== activePage) return;
      selectSlot(slot);
      const f = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
      if (f) loadFile(f, slot);
    });
  });

  fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
    if (selected && fileInput.files[0]) loadFile(fileInput.files[0], selected);
    fileInput.value = "";
  });

  loadBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (selected) fileInput.click();
  });

  fitBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    const s = state[key(selected)];
    if (!s.dataUrl) return;
    s.mode = s.mode === "contain" ? "cover" : "contain";
    const img = selected.querySelector("img");
    if (img) img.style.objectFit = s.mode;
    selectSlot(selected);
  });

  removeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    state[key(selected)].dataUrl = null;
    const img = selected.querySelector("img");
    if (img) img.remove();
    selectSlot(selected);
  });

  clearBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    activeSlots().forEach(slot => {
      state[key(slot)] = {dataUrl:null,mode:"contain"};
      const img = slot.querySelector("img");
      if (img) img.remove();
    });
    selectSlot(null);
  });

  function drawPlaced(ctx,img,x,y,w,h,mode) {
    const iw=img.naturalWidth, ih=img.naturalHeight;
    const scale=mode==="cover" ? Math.max(w/iw,h/ih) : Math.min(w/iw,h/ih);
    const dw=iw*scale, dh=ih*scale;
    const dx=x+(w-dw)/2, dy=y+(h-dh)/2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(x,y,w,h);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle="#050505";
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
    ctx.drawImage(img,dx,dy,dw,dh);
    ctx.restore();
  }


  async function makeCompositeDataUrl(pageName) {
    const cfg = configs[pageName];
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = cfg.width;
    canvas.height = cfg.height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    const bg = new Image();
    await new Promise((res,rej) => {
      bg.onload=res; bg.onerror=rej; bg.src=cfg.bg;
    });
    ctx.drawImage(bg,0,0,cfg.width,cfg.height);

    const pageSlots = allSlots.filter(s => s.dataset.page === pageName);
    for (const slot of pageSlots) {
      const s = state[key(slot)];
      if (!s.dataUrl) continue;

      const x=parseFloat(slot.style.left)/100*cfg.width;
      const y=parseFloat(slot.style.top)/100*cfg.height;
      const w=parseFloat(slot.style.width)/100*cfg.width;
      const h=parseFloat(slot.style.height)/100*cfg.height;

      const img=new Image();
      await new Promise((res,rej) => {
        img.onload=res; img.onerror=rej; img.src=s.dataUrl;
      });
      drawPlaced(ctx,img,x,y,w,h,s.mode);
    }
    return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
  }

  async function openLightbox(pageName=activePage) {
    try {
      lightboxImage.src = await makeCompositeDataUrl(pageName);
      lightbox.classList.add("open");
      lightbox.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    } catch(e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("No se ha podido abrir la vista ampliada.");
    }
  }

  function closeLightbox() {
    lightbox.classList.remove("open");
    lightbox.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
    document.body.style.overflow = "";
  }

  document.querySelectorAll(".lightbox-trigger").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      openLightbox(btn.dataset.page);
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".stage").forEach(stage => {
    stage.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      openLightbox(stage.closest(".view").dataset.view);
    });
  });

  lightboxClose.addEventListener("click", closeLightbox);
  lightbox.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target === lightbox) closeLightbox();
  });
  lightboxImage.addEventListener("dblclick", closeLightbox);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && lightbox.classList.contains("open")) closeLightbox();
  });

  exportBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    exportBtn.disabled = true;
    exportBtn.textContent = "Generando…";
    try {
      const cfg = configs[activePage];
      const a=document.createElement("a");
      a.download=cfg.filename;
      a.href=await makeCompositeDataUrl(activePage);
      a.click();
    } catch(e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("No se ha podido exportar la imagen.");
    } finally {
      exportBtn.disabled=false;
      exportBtn.textContent="Exportar esta página en PNG";
    }
  });

  try {
    const savedZoom = localStorage.getItem("pavon_stage_zoom");
    if (savedZoom) {
      zoomRange.value = savedZoom;
      applyZoom(savedZoom);
    } else {
      applyZoom(88);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    applyZoom(88);
  }

  zoomRange.addEventListener("input", () => applyZoom(zoomRange.value));

  renderList();
  renderCalendar();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
